<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.33.0-beta -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat: Show video pipeline flow in diagnostics and improve settings UX by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/51
* feat: Add LG Smart TV compatibility with shared HLS config by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/55
### Bug Fixes
* fix: Display update errors immediately when user initiates update by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/50
* fix: Pass isAuthenticated to data-fetching hooks to prevent race condition by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/54
* fix: Live reanalyze with startup skip for NVR compatibility by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/57
* fix: Skip license server calls in dev mode and align badges to design principles by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/59
* fix: Clean up orphaned FFmpeg processes on startup by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/60
### Documentation
* docs: Update documentation for recent PRs by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/58
### Other Changes
* chore: Migrate slash commands to skills directory by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/52
* chore: Migrate slash commands to skills directory by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/53
* refactor: Extract FormError component and align UI patterns by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/56


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/v0.32.0-beta...v0.33.0-beta
